notes:
- Silicone insert: GnomeShell won't build while the insert pokes through the latex.
- Scan tab: one section open at a time, in order of use. The view's checkboxes are in one Show menu.
- Build screen: With latex shows the shell see-through, Plates looks from higher up with each piece labeled, and the panel waits while a build runs.
- Clearer names in Settings, US spelling, and better keyboard use, contrast and small-window layout.
- Safer: only GnomeShell's own window can send it commands, and updates install from the tagged release.
